alternatives_rejected.why: Own spans self-time p50 is unchanged (0.01->0.01ms, 0.91x), so the service is not slower at its own work; only inbound latency rose (E2).

Inbound latency rose about 96x while the error rate stayed small (0.0185) (E2). That looks like added delay rather than dropped packets, though no log check for retries or timeouts was run to rule loss out.

Its latency-90 deviation (z=17299.64) is smaller than productcatalogservice's (z=26939.8) (E1). E2/E3 place the latency inflation on productcatalogservice's inbound calls. The call relationship between the two services was not confirmed with service_map.

proposed_fix.description: Remove the injected network delay on the productcatalogservice pod's interface (for example, clear the tc netem qdisc), or reschedule the pod. Then confirm that inbound p50 returns to about 2ms and frontend errors clear.
